title: Built a crypto screener from scratch (live charts, L2, AI chat, even ML) — would love people to test it
author: TrainerTechnical4049
selftext:
hey, so for a while I’ve been building this crypto screener with AI helping me code, and it’s finally at a point where I want strangers on the internet to click around and roast it.

site: [https://cryptoscreener.great-site.net](https://cryptoscreener.great-site.net/)  
(guest works without signup — open screener, poke around)

not selling signals or a token. just a tool I actually use / want feedback on.

the screener

basically a live market table for USDT pairs. you can filter, sort, change columns, search, switch between list / boxes, mobile layout too. guests get the top 100; free/pro/max unlock more coins and heavier scans.

the main thing I’m proud of is technical screens — stack conditions like EMA / SMA / RSI / MACD (AND logic), pick timeframe, run it against real local kline data. not some fake demo candles. also saved screens + watchlists once you’re signed in, depending on plan.

there’s also compare (pro), CSV export, coin overview, sparklines, preferences, dark mode, the usual “make it feel like a real product” stuff.

**analysis / charts**

click a coin and you get an analysis workspace with a live TradingView-style chart (lightweight-charts), local candles when the API is up, falls back to Binance if the tunnel is weird.

you can draw attention to patterns on the chart (H&S, double top/bottom, etc), leave notes per pair, and there’s position size / risk-reward type trading tools in there. not trying to be TradingView — just enough to actually look at a setup without leaving the site.

**L2 / order book (Max tier)**

this was a whole rabbit hole. live depth + tape for the top volume pairs, walls / big prints, flow-ish columns on the screener, and an “unusual activity” scan when something looks off on the book.

order book panel + analysis book view so you can stare at bids/asks while the chart is open. still rough in places but the plumbing is real (websocket collector → disk → API → UI).

**backend / live data (the boring part that took forever)**

runs off my machine basically: ticker collector, klines collector (multi TF websockets), L2 collector, local API, then a tunnel so the hosted site can talk to it. whole `npm run live` stack.

indicators get cached (SMA/EMA etc), screens hit disk instead of hammering Binance every click. hosting is InfinityFree + tunnel for now — free and janky sometimes, if charts look empty the tunnel probably died, refresh / try again.

also: auth via Supabase (email + Google), free / pro / max tiers, pricing + support pages, admin helper so I can start/stop the live stack remotely. payments aren’t real Stripe yet — tiers are there for structure.

**AI market chat**

you can talk to a market assistant on the site (account-gated). backend can use local Ollama or cloud (Groq etc), plus web search fallbacks, and a small “facts” engine so it doesn’t just hallucinate random numbers when it can look things up / compute.

not ChatGPT with a crypto skin — more “ask about the market / a coin / a setup” while you’re already in the screener. still early; if it says something dumb tell me.

**ML side (more for nerds)**

been building a feature factory off the klines — feature CSVs, multi-symbol 15m datasets, train script with honest baselines + simple paper PnL so I’m not lying to myself with accuracy. not a “guaranteed money bot” button on the homepage. more like research infra I’m wiring toward the product later.

*misc one-liners so this doesn’t turn into a novel*

* pattern markers + little info cards when you click them
* price / condition alerts + toast notifications (Max)
* L2 activity scan modal
* download data modal / persistence for screens
* support chat widget + landing / pricing / support site chrome
* column settings, rank-by, classification filters, exchange filters on higher tiers
* trading calculators (size, R:R)
* facts CLI / lessons store for the AI side

**if you try it**: please just click around like a normal person. guest browse is fine. signup if you want saves. tell me what’s confusing, what’s broken, what’s missing, what feels scammy (pls don’t say the domain lmao I know it’s free hosting).

screenshots / “I clicked X and Y broke” are gold. even “UI looks meh” is useful.

built a lot of this with AI in the loop — still my project, still my mess to maintain. curious what actual traders / builders think.

link again: [https://cryptoscreener.great-site.net](https://cryptoscreener.great-site.net/)

thanks if you give it 2 minutes.
